data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 宅邸花园
data.description: 【爱蜜莉雅 · 宅邸花园】阳光明媚的罗兹瓦尔宅邸玫瑰园里，爱蜜莉雅坐在石桌旁，手心里托着打哈欠的大精灵帕克。看到你端着茶点走来，她露出了毫无阴霾的灿烂笑容——「昴！帕克刚才还在夸你泡的花草茶超级好喝呢！快过来一起坐下吃点心吧！」
data.action: 与契约精灵帕克在花间小憩
data.promptProse: Emilia rests among the Roswaal garden flowers with the small nonhuman spirit Puck, laughing as the companion hovers close to her hands. White-and-lilac dress and soft ribbon retain her signature appearance. The medium view includes blooms overlapping the seated pause and fluttering butterflies farther back along the garden. Warm summer daylight catches her silver hair, Puck's outline and petal edges, leaving gentle foliage shade beneath their quiet meeting.
